nodes.text: Let $k\geq 2$. Is it true that there exists an interval $I$ of width $(e-1+o(1))k$ and integers $n_1<\cdots<n_k\in I$ such that\[1=\frac{1}{n_1}+\cdots+\frac{1}{n_k}?\]

#286 : [ErGr80,p.33] number theory | unit fractions The answer is yes, proved by Croot [Cr01] .
